remaining_regressions.decomposition_path: encoder first, head second; contributions are path-dependent, not Shapley causal attribution

interpretation: Strong pooled MSE retention does not preserve discriminative class gaps. Both encoder and head changes reduce every observed regressed glyph's gap to the retained model's actual wrong Top-1. Restoring the last encoder layer or either full component recovers many cases, without demonstrating a universal capacity limit or a safe deployed replacement.
